name: Dinomogetimarus

attributes.attribute: a Gaulish god known from a single inscription
identified by the Romans with Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dinomogetimarus was a god of the continental Celts. Only one inscription names this Gaulish god. The Romans identified him with their warrior divinity Mars. He is known today from that single text.

okr.objective: Document the Gaulish god Dinomogetimarus and his equation with Mars.
key_results: The Romans identified him with their warrior divinity Mars
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
